handoff: Added MAP_SCALE_UP 1.4 and PLANET_SCALE_UP 1.3 in game/map.gd. MAP_UNIT_SCALE is now 0.02 x 1.4, so planet orbits (about system centre), asteroid clusters, pack radii, route lines, cluster picks, system exits (system_exit.gd copy of the constant), dust rings, ship docking and the pathfinder all scale together. START_ZOOM, zoom_min, PAN_SPEED, PAN_LIMIT_MIN and LAYOUT_RADIUS are scaled with it, so framing is unchanged. Planet size range, base size and pick minimum are x1.3; label offsets, hints and docking follow planet_radius, so ships still spawn outside planets. Suns and rock sizes are unchanged. Travel time is unchanged: pathfinder speed is in data units times MAP_UNIT_SCALE, so distance and speed both grow 1.4x. Test run: no FAIL lines.
